title: deadcode-scanner Findings
description: Canonical intermediate format produced by knip-detector and consumed by report-writer and fix-writer.

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this document.

scanner.description: Underlying tool actually used (e.g. knip, knip --fix).

scanned_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this scan started.

target.description: Repo path the scan was applied to.

status.description: Outcome. 'ok/partial/failed/skipped' for knip-detector; PR statuses for fix-writer. report-writer surfaces 'partial' and 'failed' explicitly.

status_reason.description: Required when status is 'partial', 'failed', or 'skipped'. One-line explanation.

evidence_path.description: Path to the raw knip JSON output preserved for audit, e.g. deadcode-reports/<timestamp>/deadcode-evidence/knip.json.

fix_result.description: Present only in fix-writer output. Records what knip --fix changed and where the PR lives.

id.description: Stable identifier derived from file path + symbol name only (never line numbers), e.g. DEAD-EXPORT-src/utils.ts#unusedFn, DEAD-DEP-lodash. Used for .deadcode-ignore suppression and delta matching.

severity.description: Dead code caps at MEDIUM (unused/unlisted dependencies). Unused files and duplicate exports are LOW; unused exports/types are INFO.

location.description: Repo-relative file:line where the finding was observed. 'package.json' for dependency findings.

description.description: 1-2 sentence explanation of the issue and its impact.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence (e.g. the export signature, dependency version).

suppressed.description: Set to true if matched against .deadcode-ignore. Report-writer excludes from the main view but logs in the suppression section.

handler_file.description: Repo-relative file path containing the dead code. Pairs with handler_line to produce a clickable code reference in the report.

handler_line.description: Line number within handler_file, from Knip's reported position.

fix.description: Remediation guidance attached to this finding. The 'mechanically_fixable' flag controls whether fix-writer's knip --fix pass covers this finding when --fix is passed. Nothing is ever auto-applied to the working tree — delivery is always via a draft PR for human review.

mechanically_fixable.description: True for remove-export, remove-file (only when --include-files), and remove-dependency — categories knip --fix handles safely. False for guide-only categories (duplicates, unlisted, unresolved) which need human judgment.

command.description: Scoped shell command for a manual fix, e.g. 'npx knip --fix --fix-type exports' or 'npm uninstall lodash'. Empty for guide-only.

verification.description: Imperative step to confirm the fix is safe (e.g. 'Re-run /deadcode; run the project build and tests').

applied.description: Set to true by fix-writer when a PR covering this finding has been opened. 'Applied' means 'PR proposed' — not 'merged'.

pr_url.description: URL of the draft PR that covers this finding. Null until fix-writer runs successfully.
